decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is a core part of the firm's coolant management portfolio and supports high-pressure machining, so keeping it is consistent with its strategy.
The cleaning centrifuge complements the firm's filtration systems and its sustainability positioning, so it remains a sensible part of the offer.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's core conveying business for metalworking customers.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are among the most widely used conveyor types and central to the firm's established offer.
